title: Snap your food
intro: Record wetin you chop for few seconds, or check where Living Dose product come from.

photo.title: Snap picture of your plate
photo.body: E go save with your food diary, so you and your dietitian fit look am again.
photo.error: We no fit read that picture. Abeg try another one.

plate.title: Wetin dey your plate?
plate.body: Search and add each part of your food, then choose how big the portion be.
plate.noResults: We no see anything. Try simple word, like rice or soup.

review.title: Check am and save
review.saltHigh: Salt plenty for this one food. Big person suppose take less than 5 g for the whole day.
review.saved: E don save for your food diary.
review.estimates: Na estimate be these. Food wey dem cook for house no dey the same size.

diary.title: Today food diary
diary.removeConfirm: You wan delete this food from your diary?
diary.planNote: Food wey you tick for your meal plan dey count for your Home page.

guest.title: Sign in make you keep food diary
guest.body: Your food, pictures and totals na private, na only you go see dem.

product.title: Scan product
product.body: Every Living Dose product get code for the label. Scan am make you see where your food come from.
product.cameraHelp: Point your camera to the QR code wey dey the label.
product.cameraError: We no fit open the camera. You fit type the code instead.
product.noCamera: Camera scan no dey work for this browser. Type the code wey dey under the QR code instead.
product.invalid: We no know that code. Check say e be like the one for the label, for example LD-UGU-B0930.
product.harvested_one: Dem harvest am {{count}} day before dem pack am
product.harvested_other: Dem harvest am up to {{count}} days before dem pack am
product.packed: Dem check am and pack am for Living Dose hub, Lagos
product.noTrace: Dem make this product for our kitchen with ingredients wey you fit trace.

ai.asInPhoto: as e be for your picture
ai.found_one: We see {{count}} item. Check am and correct anything wey we no get right.
ai.found_other: We see {{count}} items. Check dem and correct anything wey we no get right.
ai.noFood: We no see any food for that picture. Try again, put the plate for middle, where light dey well.
ai.unavailable: Automatic check never on for here, so add your food for down.
ai.error: We no fit read your plate now. Add your food for down.
ai.estimate: AI estimate for wetin dey your picture

tips.saltHigh: Salt plenty for this food. Big person suppose take less than 5 g for the whole day, so reduce Maggi and salty snacks for the rest of today.
tips.sugaryDrink: Next time, change the sweet drink to water or zobo wey no get sugar. That one alone fit save you plenty teaspoon of sugar.
tips.fried: Something here na fry. Next time, try boiled or roasted plantain, moi moi instead of akara, or grilled fish.
tips.addVeg: Add vegetable: small ugu, spinach or salad go make this food balance well.
tips.bigSwallow: That swallow big o. Make am reach the size of your fist, and add more vegetable for the soup.
tips.bigMeal: This food big. Make the next one light, and waka small after you chop.
tips.addProtein: Protein no plenty for this food. Add beans, egg, fish or chicken, e go hold your belle well.
tips.balanced: E balance well: vegetable, protein and salt no too much. Continue like this!

water.title: Water challenge
water.intro: Drink 8 glass today. Snap live selfie anytime you drink, and we go count the glass for you.
water.goalDone: You don reach today target. You do well!
water.how: Carry your glass or bottle reach your mouth, make your face show for the picture. E must be live picture wey you snap now.
water.accepted: We don count the glass! Continue like that.
water.demoAccepted: We don count the glass. (Demo: we no check the selfie.)
water.rejected: We no fit confirm that one. Make sure say your face and your drink dey the picture.
water.notSetUp: Selfie check never on, so we no count this glass. Abeg try again later.
water.checkFailed: We no fit check your selfie now. Abeg try again small time.
water.tooSoon_one: Nice one! Wait {{count}} minute before your next glass.
water.tooSoon_other: Nice one! Wait {{count}} minutes before your next glass.
water.max: That water don do for today. Well done!
water.privacy: Na only live camera, so person no fit upload picture. We dey check say real face and drink dey the picture; we no dey find out who you be. Your selfies go stay for this phone and dem go clear tomorrow.

camera.label: Live camera
camera.deniedBody: To snap water selfie, allow camera for this site for your browser settings, then reload the page.
camera.unsupportedBody: This browser no fit open camera. Try Chrome or Safari for your phone.
